Label.Tooltip: Vanilla: maps and compasses stay in their usual chests. Own Dungeon: maps and compasses are shuffled among the chests of their own dungeon. Remove: their chests hold a Blue Rupee and you never get them. Start With: a new save already has every dungeon's map and compass, and the chests that held them are randomized like any other check (a bonus item joins the pool for each: rupees up to Gold, Bombchus, ammo, sometimes a Piece of Heart).

Label.Tooltip: Own Dungeon shuffles small keys inside their dungeon. The logic has no door-by-door key model, so a key can end up behind its own locked door. Removed: every dungeon starts with all its small keys, so every locked door opens; the small key chests hold other items. Key rings: the remake's small keys count for whichever dungeon you pick them up in, so a key can't be placed in another dungeon. Instead each dungeon with a key ring (see Key Ring Dungeons) gets one Key Ring item that gives all of its small keys at once, wherever it is found: in any dungeon, only outside dungeons (Overworld), or anywhere. The small key chests of those dungeons hold other items. The logic expects the key ring before anything in its dungeon. (From OotrR.)

Label.Tooltip: Own Dungeon puts the boss key in a chest of its own dungeon (same caveat as small keys). Removed: the five temples (Forest, Fire, Water, Shadow, Spirit) start with their boss key; the boss key chests hold other items. Any Dungeon / Anywhere: each temple's boss key becomes an item of its own ("Boss Key (Forest Temple)") that opens that temple's boss door wherever it is found: in any dungeon, or anywhere. The logic expects it before anything in its temple. Ganon's Castle's boss key stays where it is. (From OotrR.)

Label.Tooltip: This many dungeons, chosen by the seed, are barren: nothing in them is needed to finish the game. Their shuffled checks hold rupees only: no key items, songs, boss rewards, key rings or other junk. A barren dungeon's own keys stay in it when keys stay in their own dungeons. The dungeon's boss reward, boss Heart Container and song (Sheik in the Ice Cavern) are put somewhere else in the seed, whatever the reward, song and heart settings; their checks hold rupees too. Dungeons that can be barren: the Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Jabu-Jabu's Belly, the Forest, Fire, Water, Shadow and Spirit Temples, the Bottom of the Well, the Ice Cavern and the Gerudo Training Ground (never Ganon's Castle). The altar in the Temple of Time names the barren dungeons.
